items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if the receiptId is null
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果 receiptId 为 null

items.source: Variant of addReceiptTask(Runnable) with a Consumer of the headers from the RECEIPT frame.
items.translation: `addReceiptTask(Runnable)` 的变体，用于从 `RECEIPT` 帧中获取标题的 `Consumer`。

items.source: Return the receipt id, or null if the STOMP frame for which the handle was returned did not have a "receipt" header.
items.translation: 返回收据 ID，或者如果为返回句柄的 STOMP 帧没有“receipt”标头，则返回 `null`。

items.source: Task to invoke when a receipt is not received in the configured time.
items.translation: 未在规定时间内收到收据时调用的任务。

items.source: Task to invoke when a receipt is received.
items.translation: 接收收据时要调用的任务。

items.source: A handle to use to track receipts.
